name: Killymoon Creek introductory walk
description:
Date: Saturday, 1 August 2026
Leader: Molly Hoey
RSVP: molly.hoey1@gmail.com
Places: Limited to 15
Grade: L55
L = Duration: Long - 6 to 8 hours
5 = Terrain: Sustained rough terrain, creek walking, boulder hopping, moderate scrub, some scrambling
5 = Fitness: Solid - good fitness needed for a full day out
Full-day introductory creek walk with rock hopping, hands-on scrambling, uneven creek terrain, and a swim stop. Beginner-friendly for off-track walkers, but still a long day.
Beginner-friendly, but off-track with creek hopping, rock scrambling, and uneven terrain. 
https://townsvillebushwalkingclub.com/club-walk-grading-system/
Non-members/guests: $5 club fee

Molly will be leading a full-day walk to Killymoon Creek, a scenic dry-season creek adventure featuring rocky gullies, granite slabs, and a beautiful gorge. This walk is suitable for beginners with a moderate level of fitness (you should be able to walk up and down Castle Hill with ease). 

The walk begins on a fire trail across private property, with a few hills to warm up the legs before dropping into the creek system. From there, the group will follow the creek bed upstream, rock hopping and scrambling through small rocky gullies that gradually open into a more spectacular gorge.

Lunch will be at a swimming hole, where anyone keen for a cold dip can have a swim before the group turns around and follows the creek back out.

Although this walk is beginner-friendly, it is still an off-track creek walk. Participants will need a reasonable level of fitness, good balance, and confidence moving over rocks, boulders, and uneven ground. There will be some hands-on scrambling, so gloves are strongly recommended.

Meeting point:
Meet at 7:00 am. The exact meeting location will be emailed to those who RSVP.

Expected finish: 
This is a full-day walk, with an estimated return to the car park around 4:00 pm.

What to bring:
Please bring at least 4 litres of water, as the availability of suitable drinking water from the creek cannot be guaranteed. You will also need lunch, snacks, electrolytes, basic first aid, sun-safe clothing, sunscreen, insect repellent, and sturdy footwear with good grip.

Gloves are strongly recommended, as there will be plenty of hands-on rock work during the walk.

RSVP:
To RSVP, please contact Molly Hoey at molly.hoey1@gmail.com.

Places are limited to 15.

The events are free for members and non-members. However, after completing three club walks, you must apply to become a member.

Clicking "Going" on Facebook does not register you for the event. Also, note that the location listed on the Facebook Event is not necessarily where we are meeting. The meeting location and final details will be emailed to you by the walk leader once you have RSVP'd.

Please read the Townsville Bushwalking Club’s Walker Guidelines and What to Bring information on the club website before attending.
